   - Salvager gets a +1/+1 counter (now 5/4).
   - Wayward Disciple triggers: opponent loses 1 life (10 → 9), you gain 1.
   - Doomed Dissenter's trigger creates a 2/2 black Zombie token (Zombie B).
   - A creature died under your control, so Bontu can now attack.
5. Declare attackers: Bontu (6/7, menace), Wayward Disciple (4/5), Defiant Salvager (5/4), Zombie A (4/3), and Zombie B (2/2) — 21 total power.
